conclusion: The PDF faithfully plots the recorded CSV numbers, but those numbers mix BPB schemas. Fresh saved source metrics use schema2 at target p55, p60, p65, p80 and legacy/no-version BPB at the other target coordinates. Identical metric keys do not establish a common metric definition. The p70 discontinuity is not a sorting, mapping, smoothing, or stale-PDF issue.
interpolation_caveat: Pilot-chord residuals describe cohort-associated geometry only. They do not estimate a cohort effect, prove a runtime mismatch, or establish smoothness of true target loss.
